task: Freeze the reaction-factorized surrogate, the synthesis-aware batch-acquisition policy, the retrospective benchmark protocol and the pass/fail gate, before any result exists.

why_this_experiment.diagnosis: Generation is not the bottleneck (92.1% terminal admission, 26,235 distinct products) and routing is not the bottleneck among rankable designs (97.1% of prediction-supported designs resolve to purchasable material). The bottleneck is the activity model: under component-family-aware cross-validation the production D-MPNN ensemble reaches Spearman 0.469 on held aldehyde families, which a component-additive ridge matches.
why_this_experiment.question: Given that diagnosis, does choosing an experimental batch by reaction-factorized information gain under a synthesis budget collect more informative data than score ranking or diversity selection, without giving up plausible activity or feasibility?
why_this_experiment.what_this_is_not: This is not a claim that the generator should be guided by the activity model. Nothing here changes generation. The surrogate chooses which already-generated, already-route-complete designs to measure.

surrogate.rationale: Chosen for an auditable closed-form posterior, not for accuracy. Every acquisition rule reads the posterior covariance, so a model whose uncertainty we cannot write down would put the uncertainty estimate and the acquisition in an unauditable loop.

features.counts_not_bits_because: binary folded Morgan fingerprints are blind to alkyl chain length; this project measured 30 generated pairs at Tanimoto 1.000 differing by 14 to 182 Da, and homologues are exactly what the generator produces
features.n_bits_rationale: 256 per block, so the design matrix is 1024-dimensional. The greedy batch loop forms Sigma M Sigma once per step, which is cubic in that dimension; 1024 keeps a full six-arm five-seed benchmark tractable while leaving the linear model far wider than the 1,100 measured lipids can constrain. Set before any benchmark result existed.

acquisition.objective: greedy budgeted maximisation of value_weight * normalised_conservative_bound + (1 - value_weight) * normalised_variance_reduction_over_target, divided by synthetic cost
acquisition.activity_floor_rationale: A hard filter applied before any trade-off, so exploration can never mean synthesising a design the surrogate expects to fail. Expressed as a quantile of the feasible pool so it does not depend on the endpoint scale.
acquisition.cost_definition: number of precursor preparations required before the final Ugi assembly
acquisition.target_population: the route-complete, prediction-supported generated population; information is measured over the designs we would actually want to rank, not over the whole space
acquisition.greedy_rather_than_exact_because: the information term is recomputed against a posterior that changes as the batch grows, and a batch of a dozen from a pool of thousands does not warrant an exact combinatorial solve

retrospective_benchmark.split_rationale: A random split would let a tail seen in the seed set reappear in the pool, which inflates every acquisition arm equally and hides the differences that matter.

gate.decision_rule: Proceed to a second synthesised library only if the reaction-factorized arm beats BOTH score-only ranking and component-diversity selection on the primary criterion, on a majority of seeds, without exceeding the fixed synthetic budget.

must_not_regress.top_decile_hits_found: no worse than the best baseline minus 1

gate.if_the_gate_fails: Stop. Report the negative result and do not synthesise a second library. A second library exists to test the acquisition method, not to decorate the paper.
gate.no_retuning_after_seeing_results: value_weight, activity_floor_quantile, role_weights, prior_variance and noise_variance are frozen by this file. Changing any of them after seeing benchmark output invalidates the gate and requires a new versioned config.

library_1.what: the existing frozen 40-candidate panel, 34 HIGH plus 6 LOW
library_1.question: can the original FORGE pipeline produce experimentally useful ionizable lipids?

library_2.what: a batch selected by the acquisition policy above from a fresh generated pool
library_2.status: not generated; conditional on the gate passing
library_2.selection: algorithmic, with a prespecified chemistry feasibility or safety veto only, no intuition reranking after the candidates are seen
library_2.pool_construction: union of a broad-prior draw and a support-enriched draw, deduplicated, then the same admission, support, route and envelope filters, so the panel does not depend on one arbitrary proposal distribution
library_2.question: does product-component-aware batch design collect more informative data without giving up plausible activity or feasibility?

library_3.what: a small confirmatory batch selected after Library 1 and 2 measurements update the surrogate
library_3.status: not designed; conditional on Round 1 measurements existing
library_3.note: only a design round that actually depends on prior experimental results may be described as closed-loop

nonclaims: A variance reduction is not a discovery.
A credible bound from this Gaussian surrogate is not the distribution-free conformal guarantee used for candidate ranking elsewhere in the project.
Route completeness constrains which designs are affordable to measure; it is not evidence that a synthesis will succeed.
Passing the retrospective gate does not establish that the method works prospectively.
